audit_status.review_note: Waiting, rescue, sacrifice, Torah, proclamation, enemies, and textual-witness difference.

verses.restored: I waited patiently for YHWH; and he inclined to me, and heard my cry.

familiar.text: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

modern.text: I waited patiently for the LORD; He inclined to me and heard my cry.

original.text: לַ֝מְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָוִ֥ד מִזְמֽוֹר קַוֺּ֣ה קִוִּ֣יתִי יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥ט אֵ֝לַ֗י וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע שַׁוְעָתִֽי

verses.restored: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

familiar.text: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

modern.text: He lifted me up from the pit of despair, out of the miry clay; He set my feet upon a rock, and made my footsteps firm.

original.text: וַיַּעֲלֵ֤נִי מִבּ֥וֹר שָׁאוֹן֮ מִטִּ֪יט הַיָּ֫וֵ֥ן וַיָּ֖קֶם עַל סֶ֥לַע רַגְלַ֗י כּוֹנֵ֥ן אֲשֻׁרָֽי

verses.restored: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in YHWH.

familiar.text: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.

modern.text: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.

original.text: וַיִּתֵּ֬ן בְּפִ֨י שִׁ֥יר חָדָשׁ֮ תְּהִלָּ֪ה לֵֽאלֹ֫הֵ֥ינוּ יִרְא֣וּ רַבִּ֣ים וְיִירָ֑אוּ וְ֝יִבְטְח֗וּ בַּיהוָֽה

verses.restored: Blessed is that man that maketh YHWH his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

familiar.text: Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

modern.text: Blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust, who has not turned to the proud, nor to those who lapse into falsehood.

original.text: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי הַגֶּ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֣ם יְ֭הֹוָה מִבְטַח֑וֹ וְֽלֹא פָנָ֥ה אֶל רְ֝הָבִ֗ים וְשָׂטֵ֥י כָזָֽב

verses.restored: Many, O YHWH my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order to thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.

familiar.text: Many, O LORD my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.

modern.text: Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us— none can compare to You— if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count.

original.text: רַבּ֤וֹת עָשִׂ֨יתָ אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַי֮ נִֽפְלְאֹתֶ֥יךָ וּמַחְשְׁבֹתֶ֗יךָ אֵ֫לֵ֥ינוּ אֵ֤ין עֲרֹ֬ךְ אֵלֶ֗יךָ אַגִּ֥ידָה וַאֲדַבֵּ֑רָה עָ֝צְמ֗וּ מִסַּפֵּֽר

verses.restored: Sacrifice and offering you did not desire; ears you have opened for me. Burnt offering and sin offering you did not require.

familiar.text: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.

notes.title: Ears opened / body prepared
notes.body: The Masoretic Hebrew reads literally “ears you have dug/opened for me.” The Greek Septuagint has “a body you prepared for me,” the form cited in Hebrews 10:5. Both witnesses should remain visible rather than harmonized.

modern.text: Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but my ears You have opened. Burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not require.

original.text: זֶ֤בַח וּמִנְחָ֨ה לֹֽא חָפַ֗צְתָּ אָ֭זְנַיִם כָּרִ֣יתָ לִּ֑י עוֹלָ֥ה וַ֝חֲטָאָ֗ה לֹ֣א שָׁאָֽלְתָּ

verses.restored: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,

familiar.text: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,

modern.text: Then I said, “Here I am, I have come— it is written about me in the scroll:

original.text: אָ֣ז אָ֭מַרְתִּי הִנֵּה בָ֑אתִי בִּמְגִלַּת סֵ֝֗פֶר כָּת֥וּב עָלָֽי

verses.restored: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.

familiar.text: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.

modern.text: I delight to do Your will, O my God; Your law is within my heart.”

original.text: לַֽעֲשֽׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ֣ אֱלֹהַ֣י חָפָ֑צְתִּי וְ֝ת֥וֹרָתְךָ֗ בְּת֣וֹךְ מֵעָֽי

verses.restored: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O YHWH, thou knowest.

familiar.text: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.

modern.text: I proclaim righteousness in the great assembly; behold, I do not seal my lips, as You, O LORD, do know.

original.text: בִּשַּׂ֤רְתִּי צֶ֨דֶק בְּקָ֘הָ֤ל רָ֗ב הִנֵּ֣ה שְׂ֭פָתַי לֹ֣א אֶכְלָ֑א יְ֝הוָ֗ה אַתָּ֥ה יָדָֽעְתָּ

verses.restored: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.

familiar.text: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.

modern.text: I have not covered up Your righteousness in my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and salvation; I have not concealed Your loving devotion and faithfulness from the great assembly.

original.text: צִדְקָתְךָ֬ לֹא כִסִּ֨יתִי בְּת֬וֹךְ לִבִּ֗י אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ וּתְשׁוּעָתְךָ֣ אָמָ֑רְתִּי לֹא כִחַ֥דְתִּי חַסְדְּךָ֥ וַ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ לְקָהָ֥ל רָֽב

verses.restored: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O YHWH: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

familiar.text: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

modern.text: O LORD, do not withhold Your mercy from me; Your loving devotion and faithfulness will always guard me.

original.text: אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה לֹא תִכְלָ֣א רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּ֑נִּי חַסְדְּךָ֥ וַ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ תָּמִ֥יד יִצְּרֽוּנִי

verses.restored: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.

familiar.text: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.

modern.text: For evils without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, so that I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart has failed within me.

original.text: כִּ֤י אָפְפ֥וּ עָלַ֨י רָע֡וֹת עַד אֵ֬ין מִסְפָּ֗ר הִשִּׂיג֣וּנִי עֲ֭וֺנֹתַי וְלֹא יָכֹ֣לְתִּי לִרְא֑וֹת עָצְמ֥וּ מִשַּֽׂעֲר֥וֹת רֹ֝אשִׁ֗י וְלִבִּ֥י עֲזָבָֽנִי

verses.restored: Be pleased, O YHWH, to deliver me: O YHWH, make haste to help me.

familiar.text: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.

modern.text: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; hurry, O LORD, to help me.

original.text: רְצֵ֣ה יְ֭הוָה לְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָׁה

verses.restored: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

familiar.text: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

modern.text: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.

original.text: יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּר֨וּ יַחַד֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י נַפְשִׁ֗י לִסְפּ֫וֹתָ֥הּ יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָ֭חוֹר וְיִכָּלְמ֑וּ חֲ֝פֵצֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי

verses.restored: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say to me, Aha, aha.

familiar.text: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.

modern.text: May those who say to me, “Aha, aha!” be appalled at their own shame.

original.text: יָ֭שֹׁמּוּ עַל עֵ֣קֶב בָּשְׁתָּ֑ם הָאֹמְרִ֥ים לִ֝֗י הֶ֘אָ֥ח הֶאָֽח

verses.restored: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, YHWH be magnified.

familiar.text: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.

modern.text: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “The LORD be magnified!”

original.text: יָ֘שִׂ֤ישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ בְּךָ֗ כָּֽל מְבַ֫קְשֶׁ֥יךָ יֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה אֹֽ֝הֲבֵ֗י תְּשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

familiar.text: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

modern.text: But I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my helper and deliverer; O my God, do not delay.

original.text: וַאֲנִ֤י עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְיוֹן֮ אֲדֹנָ֪י יַחֲשָׁ֫ב לִ֥י עֶזְרָתִ֣י וּמְפַלְטִ֣י אַ֑תָּה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אַל תְּאַחַֽר

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Sacrifice critique is not contempt for Judaism; later Christian reception must not erase the Hebrew form.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, duplicate/parallel psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
